description: This file contains unit tests for the Azure Table Storage persistence provider used within Orleans, including tests for serialization, storage conversions, and various storage implementations such as mock, file, Azure, and memory storage.

classes.name: PersistenceProviderTests_Local
classes.description: A suite of unit tests validating Azure Table Storage persistence provider functionality, including serialization and storage format conversions.

classes.name: TestStoreGrainStateWithCustomJsonProperties
classes.description: A helper class for testing JSON serialization with custom property attributes in grain state.

methods.name: InitAzureTableGrainStorage
methods.description: Initializes and configures an AzureTableGrainStorage instance with specified serialization options for testing.

methods.name: Test_PersistenceProvider_Read
methods.description: Verifies that the storage provider can accurately read the grain state.

methods.name: Test_PersistenceProvider_WriteRead
methods.description: Tests writing and then reading back grain state to ensure data integrity.

methods.name: Test_PersistenceProvider_WriteClearRead
methods.description: Tests writing, clearing, and then reading grain state to confirm state clearing.

methods.name: EnsureEnvironmentSupportsState
methods.description: Checks if the environment supports the given grain state, particularly related to Azure storage emulator usage.
